interpretation: The v2 direct profile has the same public output ABI as the earlier generic and packed-chip Bitcoin profiles, and all three natively verify a single private genesis header. The direct AIR is still slower than the generic sparse-wide circuit (429–454 ms excluding FRI PoW versus 153.626 ms median excluding both PoWs) and has a larger proof (731280 versus 338282 bytes). It is faster than the packed SHA joint's 689 ms non-FRI-PoW median, with similar proof size. The direct result still includes the small interaction grind whereas the generic reference excludes both grinds. These are two local runs under differing in-process versus CLI measurement paths and not a throughput claim.
